papers_read.title_as_printed: A Two-Stage Model for Predicting Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Conversion (Lu et al., Front. Aging Neurosci. 2022, 14:826622)

Explainable Machine Learning with Pairwise Interactions for Predicting Conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Utilizing Multi-Modalities Data (Cai et al., Brain Sci. 2023, 13, 1535)

what_each_reports.P-199: 577 ADNI baseline MCI (280 pMCI converting within 3 years, 297 sMCI); whole-brain 3D T1 MRI only, 3D ResNet-50 initialised from Med3D and pretrained with MoCo contrastive learning; random 80/20 split, test set with bootstrap CIs. Accuracy 0.819 (95% CI 0.798-0.841), SEN 0.786, SPE 0.850, AUC 0.835.
what_each_reports.P-211: 1042 ADNI-1/2/3/GO amnestic MCI; Explainable Boosting Machine on cognitive scores (ADAS13, MMSE, FAQ, CDR-SB), FreeSurfer volumes/thicknesses, demographics, baseline EMCI/LMCI diagnosis and APOE4; 90/10 split with SMOTE and 5-fold CV. Separate models for conversion within 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 years. The AUC 0.92 (accuracy 85%) is the 5-year model on cognitive + MRI features. The 3-year model (test set, with interactions) gives accuracy 0.75 and AUC 0.81.

quantity_a: ROC AUC for MCI->AD conversion within 3 years, from whole-brain T1 MRI alone (3D CNN), ADNI, internal 80/20 test.
quantity_b: ROC AUC for MCI->AD conversion within 5 years, from cognitive scores, FreeSurfer regional measures, demographics, baseline MCI subtype and APOE4 (EBM), ADNI aMCI, internal 90/10 split / 5-fold CV.
incompatible_if_same: No. On the matching 3-year horizon, P-211's own figure (AUC 0.81 on its test set) sits slightly below P-199's 0.835, and neither paper gives an AUC interval that excludes the other. The recorded 0.835 vs 0.92 gap is a 3-year vs 5-year and MRI-only vs multimodal difference.

gates.task: nominal match (T2), but the horizons differ: 3 years (P-199) vs 5 years (P-211's 0.92).
gates.dataset_family: match: both ADNI (P-211 spans ADNI-1/2/3/GO); substantial subject overlap is likely.
gates.modality_family: mismatch: P-199 uses T1 MRI only; P-211's 0.92 model combines cognitive test scores, clinical/genetic data and FreeSurfer volumes.

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric type (ROC AUC), but different endpoint horizon (3 vs 5 years) and different predictor set; cognitive scores such as CDR-SB and MMSE also enter the clinical diagnosis that defines P-211's outcome.
performance_validity: flag does not apply: no value >= 0.97.
independence: Both draw on ADNI MCI participants and very likely share subjects. Distinct author groups.
grounds: P-211's AUC 0.92 is its 5-year conversion model, while P-199's 0.835 is for conversion within 3 years; the endpoint horizons differ.

P-211's model uses cognitive scores, APOE4, demographics and baseline MCI subtype on top of MRI regional measures, while P-199 uses T1 MRI images alone; the predictor sets differ and no modality waiver is on record.
At the one shared horizon (3 years), P-211 reports AUC 0.81, close to P-199's 0.835, so there is no indication that the two studies disagree about any single quantity.

evidence_quotes.quote: As deﬁned in this study, participants with MCI at baseline who developed or did not develop AD within 3 years were referred to as pMCI and sMCI, respectively.
ResNet-50 achieved the best performance with an accuracy of 0.819 and an AUC of 0.835
The ﬁve-years prediction accuracy reached 85% (AUC = 0.92) using both cognitive scores and MRI markers.
Comb. (a) both MRI-driven biomarkers and cognitive test scores, plus age, gender, education, diagnose at baseline, and APOE4.
The main performance indicators, accuracy, sensitivity, speciﬁcity, and AUC, were 0.75, 0.78, 0.73, and 0.81 (with interaction effects)

record_defects: claim_b 'P-211: AUC 0.92 on T2' omits that 0.92 is the 5-year horizon model with cognitive + MRI + clinical features; P-211's 3-year AUC is 0.81.
modality_family 'Neuroimaging' is wrong for P-211's model, which is multimodal and dominated by cognitive/clinical features at mid-term horizons.
The P-211 registry row's Sample_N_Approx '242804' is wrong; the paper includes 1042 MCI patients.
what_would_change_the_verdict: A P-211 3-year, MRI-only result (its Comb. c) with a reported interval excluding 0.835. The paper shows Comb. c only graphically, without numbers usable for this, so it cannot be established from the PDF.
